articleTitle: Big data and the global economy
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Peculiarities of the global economy development are analyzed in this paper. The imbalance between financial and real sectors of global economy is a typical feature of its modern development. The method of analysis is also expressed in this paper. The analysis of the global economy development in context of the growing gap between the real and financial sectors is based on the system of leading indicators. Index of stability of the global economy in context of the growing gap between real and financial sectors is suggested. The index of stability allows to indicate the crisis periods. The structure of statistical data for the analysis of the global economy development allows to define the structure of the database.

Author Keywords: Gap between the Real and Monetary Sectors of Economy
Big Data and the Global Economy

articleTitle: International experience and multimodal intelligent transportation system of Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The possibilities of application and development of the INDUSTRIE 4.0 concept considered for the transport industry. One of the main opportunities is related to the creation of multimodal intelligent transportation systems (MITS) for the coordinated use of various types of transport - road, rail, sea, and aviation. MITS first generation was local and focused on solving multimodal planning and routing problems. The initial stage of development of large-scale MITS connected with the construction of some conceptual models. To create a new generation of MITS 3.0, corresponding to the concept of INDUSTRIE 4.0, intelligent networks of the interaction of various modes of transport are needed. For this, it is required to integrate information and telecommunication systems with artificial intelligence on different types of traffic. There is a need to develop intelligent information and telecommunication platforms and their application in transport. Based on the concept of INDUSTRIE 4.0, the MITS 3.0 architecture for Russia is proposed, based on information and network technologies combined with artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Advantages of a new Hyperloop transport technology
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In the paper, we consider the features of the new revolutionary transportation technology (the Hyperloop technology) proposed in the USA and associated with the use of ultra-high-speed vacuum trains moving inside tubes with a reduced internal air pressure. In doing so, we focus on Hyperloop cargo systems for transporting standard 20-foot containers. Now Russia has plans to build such a transport system in the Far East. In the paper, we examine the technical parameters of the tube and the capsule for the Hyperloop cargo systems and give some estimates for such technical and economic indicators as the cost of construction and the carrying capacity of the road. We discuss the question of what the Hyperloop technology can offer to solve serious transport problems of the modern world.

Author Keywords: new applications of the Hyperloop technology

articleTitle: The new generation of upper levels systems and industry 4.0 conception in NPP APCS
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is devoted to upper level control systems of NPP APCS (automated control systems of nuclear power plants). In the paper, a critical analysis of achievements in this area in the light of changes in the science, engineering, and society having taken places within the last 15 years is presented. New approaches to creating the new generation of upper level systems for NPP APCS and their interconnection with Industry 4.0 conception are considered. A description of new features of the next generation systems is proposed.

articleTitle: Statistical modeling of the process of generating analog information in the problems of the digital economy
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the statistical model of the analog information generation process in digital control systems for effective land use in the conditions of the digital economy formation. It is proposed to use the model for information quantitative assessment of the capabilities of BI-systems databases.

articleTitle: Optimization of the service catalog of a large-scale corporation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of designing of the services catalog with the purpose of increasing the efficiency of the management of a large corporation is considered. A centralized and decentralized model for the formation of a service catalog is considered. The problem of optimal allocation of resources for cataloging is set. Approaches to solving this problem using heuristic methods are considered. The problem of optimization of service description formats has been set, and approaches to its solution have been developed. These approaches are used to form the services catalog of the holding “Russian Railways”.

articleTitle: Distributed situational centres system of cutting edge development
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers the distributed situational centres system of cutting edge development in the context of strategic consolidation of the state, business and society, ensuring harmonization of the interests of federal, regional, local and corporate levels of management. The philosophical, psychological and technological support aspects are systematized taking into account the decision integrity, artificial intelligence, networked expertise, and convergent management issues.

articleTitle: Problems of managing the development of large-scale systems in modern conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Problems of developing a methodology and tools for managing the development of large-scale systems for solving strategic tasks in the management of industrial and transport development in Russia considered.

articleTitle: Identification of high-frequency traders using fuzzy logic methods
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Nowadays there is no single definition of high-frequency traders (HFT). In this paper HFT were classified as traders that have low value of the average of 10% of shortest position holding times, low value of the average of the ratios of end-of-day position to volume traded and high ratio of canceled orders to submitted orders. For these ratios, the fuzzy membership functions were constructed based on the analysis of the related literature. Then, for various cutoffs of membership functions, traders were classified as HFT or non-HFT. For given set of features and membership functions the share of HFT volume traded at USDRUB_TOM at MOEX FX Market (March-May 2017) was estimated between 40% and 60%.

articleTitle: Assessment of the security architecture of control system using discretionary security models
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The present paper considers a problem of assessment of cybersecurity architecture of modern digital control system using a formal hierarchical model of the cybersecurity policy. As a basis for formal security model the extended discretionary take-grant security model is presented. The formal technique used to provoke thoughts about the way how the rights and information may be passed along the systems assets under given operation conditions. The analysis has been made using an open WWW based security assessment tool Omole (omole.ws).

articleTitle: Investigation of the joint semantic environment for heterogeneous robotics
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The study is devoted to heterogeneous robotics which described by partially unknown beforehand equations of dynamics. “A window of possibilities” for research and development for heterogeneous robotics is reported. The goal of the work is the analysis of new opportunities for counterfactual modeling (forecasting and situation awareness) in carrying out search research in the development and application of modern applications of information-analytical and other types of support for complex systems. The necessity of integration components is substantiated under formation of the joint semantic environment for mixed robotic groups and their coalitions.

articleTitle: Integration of decision support systems “Kosmos” and WS-DSS with computer models
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper analyzes the approaches to the integration of decision support systems (DSS) with computer models of domains. The approach to the integration of models created in LabView is proposed. It shows how to implement the integration patterns in specific DSS: “Kosmos” and DSS WS-DSS.

articleTitle: Control of industrial automation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Automation is the only humane way to increase labor productivity in the country. The control theory of automation invariant to technological operation types, an invariant model and automation capabilities frontier are discussed. The connection between the cost of a robot and the production automation of its components is analyzed. The robotic system, which is the main instrument of industrial automation, is considered in terms of a closed self-reproducing system. An invariant theory allows estimation of the product cost in automated production. The synergetic effect is estimated arising from the industrial feedback, when robots are used to automate the production of elements of the robots themselves.

articleTitle: The concept of digital transformation of the society
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This article provides a general conceptual description of the stages of activity and society digital transformation. The description is supported by the examples from media and retail.

articleTitle: Algorithms and software for studying the impact of fuel and energy prices on the economy of the Russian federation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The software tools that were used to simulate the impacts from the change of prices for fuel and energy on economic subjects of the Russian economy are described. The equations of product input-output balances are used here to coordinate the decisions of economic subjects. An algorithm for obtaining a solution of a system of linear inequalities of this problem is proposed. It based on the method of inverse matrix and can be considered as an alternative to the simplex algorithm. Its implementation is an improvement of the software tools of the Creator and Digger complex developed earlier in ERIRAS.

Author Keywords: prices of fuel and energy resources

articleTitle: Analysis of the importance of critical objects of the gas industry with the method of determining critical elements in networks of technical infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article shows the application of the method of determining critical elements in the networks of technical infrastructures when analyzing the significance of critical gas industry facilities. Its purpose is to search for critical elements in network infrastructures and their ranking by importance. Conclusions are made about the expediency of using this method in studies of the importance of critical objects of gas industry.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity in the mathematically uniform algorithmic space of the distributed computing
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The general system properties of distributed computer systems realized in the global computing environment are analyzed. The reasons for the reproduction of heterogeneity in it and its vulnerability to unauthorized exposure of executable programs are revealed. The principles of the formation in it of the universally programmable and cybersecurity algorithmic space for distributed computing by network computers with the non-microprocessor architecture are described.

articleTitle: About the possibilities of operational gaming scenario modeling activities of enterprises and corporations
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Examines the possibilities of a holistic and coherent game modelling activities of enterprises and corporations using the theory of operational games, descriptions of awareness of players and information exchanges between them in operational gaming interactions, in which at each moment of time among different subsets of players in parallel, played a lot of static games. The possibilities of simulation of real decision-making procedures and information flow analyzed.

articleTitle: Cognitive technologies of business processes management in digital economy
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Processes of technological transformations allow moving to a qualitatively new level of technology business. This makes it possible to speak about occurrence of so-called cognitive era. In these circumstances, new management technologies and approaches are developing, in particular, the cognitive technologies in management. The paper describes the application of cognitive technologies in business processes management in digital economy.

articleTitle: A multi-agent approach for the intersectoral modeling of the Russian economy
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The intersectoral model MEMMAS was developed as a tool for describing and forecasting the economy in the context of substantial changes in the external and internal conditions of its development. MEMMAS combines a multi-agent description of the economy functioning with the interbranch input-output balance methodology. This model helped to conduct the forecasting studies of the impact of Urals oil prices on the Russian economy development. The Urals price levels were determined, which ensure positive growth rates of GDP and real disposable income of the population in 2017.

Author Keywords: Real Disposable Income of the Population

articleTitle: Vectorizing textual data sources to decrease attribute space dimension
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The main focus is given to the problem of search optimization. A new index formation method, based on attribute space is proposed. The amount of stored index is reduced by transforming metadata produced by syntax parser to a set of predefined templates with known parameters. The discussion regards issues of practical implementation related to error correction.

articleTitle: Formation of the program to improve the level of competence of the organization's staff
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the task of forming a program to increase the level of competence of the organization's staff. The proposed approach is based on the technology of developing development management systems (RMS technology) developed at the Institute of Control Sciences of the Russian Academy of Sciences with the participation of leading consultants in strategic management. The technology is based on three basic principles: a program-targeted approach, project management and effective management mechanisms. The main stages of the technology for increasing the competence of personnel are described: the goal of increasing the level of competence, taking into account the priorities of the organizational units, highlighting key problems (bottlenecks), assessing the potential for increasing the level of competence, selecting the most effective projects, and developing a schedule for the implementation of the program.

articleTitle: Robust and traditional methods of risk management in investment and construction projects
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper describes the probabilistic and statistical methods used in managing the risks of investment and construction projects. The necessity of using robust procedures in situations of significant uncertainty is stressed.

articleTitle: Electronic document management systems and distributed large-scale systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Development of document processing systems is considered. The direction of transition to the object-associated electronic document management systems is shown. The assessment of correlation of control of processes of relocation of documents and change of objects in the distributed large-scale systems is carried out.

articleTitle: Model for determining the term of execution of sub-conflicting works
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In the process of production activity, there is a need to coordinate the activities of participants in the implementation of the construction project, related to the submission of work fronts to enterprises that perform the functions of subcontractors.

articleTitle: A scenario research of the vulnerability of socio-economic systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: New applications of the methodology of scenario research of complex systems are presented. The concept of modeling and the methodology for analyzing the vulnerability of the strategic development of socio-economic systems are proposed. Examples of the analysis of the vulnerability of the strategic development of the Ivanovo region of Russia are considered.

Author Keywords: the Ivanovo region of the Russian Federation

articleTitle: Computable models of the cooperation of digital economies
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The description of a research technique of the international economic relations on the example of world model of V. Leontyev of VV is brought, optimizing tasks are formulated, substantiation for carrying out calculations are given.

articleTitle: Strategic modeling of innovative development within the framework of ensuring economic security of the regions of the Russian Federation in conditions of integration in the world economy
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The methodology for forecasting the sustainable development of the economy in the context of integrating economies into the world economy is presented in the paper. An essential element of forecasting is strategic modeling of innovative development, diversification of activities within municipalities and regions, and also within vertically integrated structures. Strategies and scenario modeling should meet the principles of increasing standards of economic sustainability for the population. Forecasting, transdisciplinary approach and scenario modeling require the ranking of business development factors; allow identifying industries with greater added value, thereby directing the efforts of small, medium or large businesses to develop certain innovative technologies for results orientation and economic security of the regions and territories.

articleTitle: The task of coordinated interaction in the international police cooperation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The effectiveness of the system of international police cooperation depends on the coordinated interaction of its subjects. The organisation of interaction of law enforcement bodies in the system is connected to the solution of a problem of the coordination of indicators of their work on various levels and directions of activity.

articleTitle: Internet service for safe queries processing in multi-server environment
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Principles of the organization of the new network service intended for protected queries processing in the distributed information systems oriented on operation in multi-server network structures are considered. The use of the service for the pipeline queries processing in a chain of servers is described.

articleTitle: Automation of heat supply in industrial enterprises
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The issues of energy efficiency and energy balance in industrial enterprises are considered. Particular attention is paid to automatic control systems for heat supply in order to achieve energy savings. The experience of development, operation and maintenance phase of monitoring, analysis and control systems at heat supply facilities of enterprises in Vladivostok is given.

articleTitle: Problem of optimal placement of data files in large-scale unreliable distributed systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Large-scale systems use distributed data processing systems in their work. An important problem in the design of such systems is the optimal allocation of data files by the nodes of the computer network. The article deals with the problem of the optimal allocation of files and their copies over the nodes of an unreliable large-scale distributed system.

articleTitle: Corporate governance quality assessment based on a balanced system of indicators
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is focused on issues of enhancing the methodological instruments of corporate governance. The concept of a new approach to quality assessment of a company's corporate governance is rationalized.

articleTitle: Infrastructure object management in the conditions of critical situations based on situational models
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A multi-level infrastructure management system, which uses the results of the simulation to solve the problem of decision-making, is considered. A feature of the proposed approach is the development of a set of situational models for various scenarios for the emergence and development of a critical situation.

articleTitle: The semantic models of large terminological texts
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The report is devoted to the systematization of large terminological texts on the basis of a hierarchical representation of definitions of concepts. By integration, such models form a semantic network of terms. Thanks to the binary, homogeneous and oriented nature of this network, it is possible to obtain a hierarchical representation model and quantitative indices indicators for evaluating the integrity of the terminological text.

Author Keywords: hierarchical model of definition of concept

articleTitle: Algorithms for workforce assignment problem
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper studies a practical problem of resource assignment and optimal human resource allocation scheduling with the objective of minimizing employees' useless working time and retire some workers. We analyze simultaneous employment staff with different competencies (skills) that needed to complete jobs. Each job and worker have a set of individual parameters. The mathematical model of assignment workers to tasks is considered. Three heuristic algorithms are performed. In addition, we show limits used for algorithms in our special case. We study NP-hardness of the problem. We propose numerical results on real data (120 competencies, 250 workers, 1000 tasks) proved potential efficiency and practical value supposed model and algorithms solving the problem. The number of required staff can be reduced by 41,7% and the total salary can be reduced by 16,5%.

articleTitle: Modern aspects of controlling the competitiveness of transport complex, based on innovative management system
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Modern aspects of innovative management in transport system are based on strategic priorities in branch development and the project management approach. This approach can solve the problem of justification of the system of criteria for selecting technical and technological innovations and assessing their competitiveness. The result of this approach is determination of the balance level of the aggregate economic and technological potential of transport complex with the quantitative and qualitative requirements (needs) of users.

articleTitle: Methodology for forecasting the global liquid fuels market
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes operational principles of the modeling tool for forecasting the world liquid fuels market, part of the ERI RAS modelling complex. The liquid fuels market forecasting Block functions as a tool for long-term forecasting of the oil industry development, government and corporate planning.

articleTitle: Modeling of production activity of a construction enterprise under analyzed law of distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Based on the representation of a construction enterprise as a queuing network consisting of a finite number of queuing systems, in which distribution laws other than exponential are used. On the basis of this model, the operating characteristics of the production system being analyzed are determined, which makes it possible, by calculation, to specify the terms for the fulfillment of contractual obligations and the necessary resources for the implementation of projects accepted for implementation.

articleTitle: Big banks' management control systems' software: Architecture. General requirements and functional components
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This report shows that the architecture of Big Banks' Management Control Systems can be presented as a two or three-tier structure without separating the functional components to the front and back office. The report also examines the key legislative and regulatory documents that define the specific requirements for the Big Banks' Management Control Systems' Software. Functional components' classification for banking management control systems' software is presented. Some of these components are considered in more detail. This paper also discusses some other categorizations of banking management control systems' functional components.

articleTitle: Effect of energy shocks on largescale system dynamics using the Uzawa two-sector macroeconomic model
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this study we consider energy shock's influence on the largescale system. We introduce research based on Uzawa two-sector macroeconomic model including three representative agents: household, goods producer and investment goods producer. Finally we make results comparison between model and historical data.

articleTitle: Social and economic power as a regulator mechanism of self-organization transport system
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this article as an object of study is considered the transport system and mechanism of self-organization. The subject of research is social and economic power in the mechanism of self-organization of the transport system. The essence of our suggested scientific hypothesis is that transport system of a different level has to be regarded as a whole system. So it needs complex measurement instrument for its effectiveness appraisal. We proposed that such an instrument should take into account the relations between technical, technological and managerial innovations and indicators that deals with the final results of transport systems functioning.

articleTitle: Trends modeling and its impact on hurst exponent at stock market fractal analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This article considers a modeling time series technique with specified characteristics of noise and trend in order to evaluate impact of these parameters on Hurst exponent, were used pseudorandom, linear and periodic signals were used as basic test signals.

articleTitle: Methodical approach of estimating infrastructure as a factor of competitive potential
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes the infrastructural potential as one of the main factors of Russian regions' competitive potential. Infrastructural factor of competitive potential is a very important element of increasing competitive advantages. The research suggests to estimate the regionals' infrastructural potential to enlarge completeness of estimating the factors of competitive potential.

articleTitle: Internal control tools used within hierarchical organizational structures
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Using the example of the Ministry of Education and Science of the RF, the work examines variants of the most effective inspections to be built and conducted in the subordinate organizations. The work includes ready models of cumulative expenditures that take into account inspection expenses as well as the losses incurred by errors and violations. The analysis tools include simulation and regression models as well as the means of multicriteria optimization.

articleTitle: Long-term improvement of the Russian gas industry development
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the long-term improvement of the Russian gas industry development model for the period of up to 2035. New approaches to forecasting gas production at major fields, transportation of pipeline gas and spot market gas purchases are being updated.

articleTitle: The evolution of innovation process organization forms: Transfer to collaboration networks and “cluster governance”
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: From the organization theory point of view the evolution of innovation process organization forms includes three phases: hierarchies, markets and networks. The work deals with the development of original “Cluster Governance” model as a specific case of collaboration network: one of the nodes accepts a role of the ≪kernel≫ providing the coordinating and infrastructure functions.

articleTitle: The problem of information security of ACS TP on the basis of program-technical complexes
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: On the information security of ACS TP negatively influenced by increasing their integration with enterprise systems management, as well as the wide spread of remote access technologies. Additional information security risks arise on the background of the smooth transition analogue of technology on hardware platform based x86, and active implementation of IP technology in the ACS environment. The combination of these factors contributes to the formation of a wide range of threats from external to the process control system network. Existing technical and policy proposals on information security mainly focused on the solution of security problems of the upper levels of management. This report focuses on the problems of information security of the lower level ACS TP and description of the proposals of the authors on the possible ways of their solution in the framework of information security systems for whole power unit.

Author Keywords: trends of development of automated control systems
the modes of parallel operation and expectations

articleTitle: Algorithms for detecting and dating the financial bubbles in real time
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This report describes algorithms for financial bubbles detection in real time mode. The various theoretical and practical aspects of algorithms for monitoring financial indexes in order to detect bubbles are presented. A comparative analysis of the properties of algorithms based on the results of experiments is carried out.

articleTitle: Fraud prevention in the system of electronic payments on the basis of POS-networks security monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Fraud prevention in the banking sphere is a very important type of activity which can cover a whole range of fraud schemes - both from employees and customers. The article studies the existing technologies for realization of the system of security control over functioning of POS networks in real time and analyzes them in detail. Besides, the concept of the system of monitoring and analysis of threats in POS networks is given, and its architecture is offered.

articleTitle: Composite algorithm for separation of the periods of a pulse signal in medical diagnostics tasks
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with algorithmic issues of the process of separating periods in the pulsed signal of the radial artery. The periodization algorithm is a set of various procedures for processing an impulse signal that can confidently allocate periods in a signal. It precedes the rest of the analysis stages. The procedures used in the algorithm are described. The expediency of their application is discussed. A block diagram of the developed algorithm for pulsed signal periodization is given. The verification of the developed algorithm was carried out on a representative sample. Several variants of the composite algorithm were implemented. As a result, an algorithm was chosen that combined the statistical algorithm and the corrective procedure - a configurable amplitude sieve. The analysis of the results of the developed algorithm has confirmed the acceptable efficiency of the periodization process for very diverse pulse signals.

articleTitle: Principles of bank assistance to economic development
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper proposes company's investment activity simulation model; on its basis we investigate the behavior of company's fundamental value under different control parameters. The interaction of bank and corporate borrower's value growth is analyzed. On the basis of regularities obtained a set of decision principles has been formulated determining bank's decision on appropriateness of financial resources placement among corporate banking market aimed at bank and corporate borrower fundamental value formation.

articleTitle: Method of diagnostics of the technological process in real time
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Emergency protection of objects in the process of testing and functioning should respond to a wide range of abnormal situations: malfunctions, which can be eliminated during testing; emergency situations that can be eliminated in the operational mode, or require the shutdown of the process and the elimination of the consequences of the accident; catastrophic situations that require an a priori reaction in order to prevent them. Ensuring technological safety in the testing of the facility and the management system of this facility requires the creation of a set of software and hardware that are united by a single approach that guarantees timely and adequate response to the problem situation with sufficient reliability. In the work, a method for diagnosing this type of process is proposed and tested on the model, which recognizes the initial (preliminary) stage of the catastrophe occurrence under the measurement conditions with the noise component. The possibility of using parallel computations for realizing diagnostics in real time is considered. The algorithms of the information-diagnostic computational complex providing automated control of the tests and operation of the object due to the connection of a complex of mathematical and imitation models of real time are considered. The admissible delay in computation time may be provided by the implementation of the algorithm on a multi-processor computing device.

articleTitle: Information operator support systems and information task of calculating technical and economical indexes of nuclear power plants
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In the paper, principles of constructing systems of information support of human-operators (IOSS) of power units of nuclear power plants (NPP) and their place within the system of upper unit-level of automated process control systems (APCS) of NPP. The purpose of implementation of the NPP IOSS is preventing or decreasing the frequency and heaviness of operator errors appearing under transients and non-regular situations, when human-operators perform under the conditions of lack of the time, fast change of the actual status, and huge volumes of information, conditioning the excessively high work load. One of tasks solved within the information support system is the task of calculating technical and economical indexes, based on intelligent data analysis.

articleTitle: Identification of the stage in the life cycle of innovation: Matrix, technique and open data
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In the article, the matrix of distribution resources and method of identification are presented, allowing to define a concrete stage of an innovative cycle of scientific research. For the analysis the text submitted in open access by natural-science division is used. The prospects of further researches with the use of open data - OD - are specified.

Author Keywords: stages of the life cycle innovation
the breaking of the innovation chain

articleTitle: Using collective mental activity techniques by system engineers at the stages of system lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Authors consider the forms and methods of collective mental activity that can be applied at the stages of system lifecycle while making decisions in a problem domain. It's especially useful at the concept development stage, where the decision-making process has more problem than solving character.

articleTitle: Features of data collection at strict schedule in distributed measurement system with ring structure
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the conditions of functioning of the distributed measurement system according to the strict schedule. The system consists of several local stations integrated into the computer network with the ring structure. Sensors of measurement system have different polling periods (polled with different frequencies) with frequencies ratios are natural numbers. Design method for the operation of that kind is proposed.

articleTitle: The methods of ranking and comparative assessment of branches of a distributed corporate system
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed method of ranking the branches of a distributed corporate systems for key performance indicators of their activities, the implementation of which gives a comparative evaluation of each of the branches for further modeling of economic and production scenarios.

Author Keywords: the problem of ranking and comparative assessment

articleTitle: Areas for the improvement in corporate governance in the Russian electric power industry
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The research identifies the priority of the improvement in Boards of Directors in the Russian power companies to enhance their corporate governance in the interests of investors. This is caused by numerous inconsistencies between the responsibility in the framework of the Boards of Directors in the current corporate practice and the principles and recommendations of the Code of Corporate Governance of Russia's Bank; the national features of the external corporate control; and an increase in the external interest in the problems of Boards of Directors in the Russian companies. The inconsistencies are determined between the current governance practice and the format of the Code developed by Moscow Stock Exchange for disclosure of information about its observance in the annual reports of companies. This format includes additional criteria from the Code which are met by the JSC “E.ON Russia”. The proposals on the necessary changes concern nomination, election, activity of the Board of Directors and assessment of their effectiveness. A special emphasis is made on the competence of members of Boards of Directors, morally-ethical and behavioral qualities, involvement in the company's activities, closeness of their financial interests to the long-term interests of investors.

articleTitle: Methods of Monte-Carlo in the problems of control at the ranks of historical data
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of control applied investment processes under risk conditions are considered. Firstly, theoretical considerations given regarding the formulation and approximate solution of the optimization problem in the presence of finite series of observation of the flow of the process. □ Secondly, we present the results of the computational experiments.

articleTitle: Application of information technologies in the problem of optimal distribution of loads on TPP with complex generating equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes the basic methodological approaches for the application of modern information technology in the task of optimum distribution of heat and electrical loads the thermal power plants (TPP) with complex equipment in various stages of station output to the market of electricity and power. Discusses the main criteria of optimization algorithms and methods of their implementation. Special attention is paid to the problem of building energy characteristics, the description of the algorithm of digitization of regulatory characteristics, the method of amending the fuel characteristics of the units to account for their current state. Given a number of methods and algorithms of optimal prices when the station output to the market of electricity and power. The possibility of simplifying this task by partitioning of plant equipment into groups in the form of equivalent units is divided by the group supply points (GSP) of electricity and thermal branches, the heat supply to external consumers.

Author Keywords: the group of points of delivery

articleTitle: The level and quality of life in Russia and the United States of America: A comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article examines key quality of life indicators and living standards at the macroeconomic and microeconomic levels. The HDI and GDP per capita of countries and the unemployment rate at the regional level were selected as indicators of the standards of living. The results of the work are the creation of the HDI growth forecast for countries, the identification of the best trend for GDP per capita and the distribution to which the regions belong in terms of the unemployment rate.

articleTitle: Setting-goals for strategic development and modelling the structure of target preferences of participants in development programs
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article deals with the possibilities of applying mathematical modelling and post-optimization analysis in the strategic planning tasks including identifying and coordinating the targets for social and economic development and justifying the mechanisms for managing development programs. An approach is proposed to restore the structure of private targeted preferences of participants in state development programs based on the results of their past activities. The basis of the computational procedure is a consequence of the Kuhn-Tucker theorem.

articleTitle: Influence of age of the borrower on demand of a consumer loan
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this research sex and age of the borrower are considered as factors influencing his intention to use lending services and a loan purpose. Target groups of clients are defined through logistic regression modeling. Implication of obtained results allows bank to increase efficiency of its credit policy in the retail market of bank crediting.

articleTitle: Evaluation of quality of city public passenger transport services
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors study the methodology of evaluation of service quality of a large system — the system of Volgograd public passenger transport. The offered decomposition and aggregate method of integral evaluation of quality is based on complex combination of quantitative (method of profiles) and qualitative (Analytical Hierarchy Process methods) approaches to measuring the hierarchically structure objects. Based on the received results and on the determined level of quality of the system of city passenger transport, the possible managerial solutions are offered.

articleTitle: Gateway software data exchange methods for Unit top level system of APCS of NPP
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Typical methods of data exchange in gateway software between Unit top level system (UTLS) and others related systems included in Automated process control system (APCS) of Nuclear power plant (NPP) are considered. Structure of gateway software, types of transferred data and algorithms of data exchange are described.

articleTitle: Models and methods of the business processes theory
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes the main directions of the modern theory of business processes. There are provided a brief overview of the main models and methods for each of these areas.

articleTitle: The methodology of assessment of economic consequences from the reduction of the regional airport network
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the analysis of the dynamics of socio-economic conditions of the cities of the Leningrad region, which in Soviet period had regional airports. The author concluded that the closure of small airports contributed to the negative trends however, a number of cities due to the opening of new industries have been able to mitigate negative conditions of economic development.

articleTitle: Modeling of adaptive organization
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: General approaches to the modeling of adaptive organizational systems are formed in the paper. The approach is based on the possibility of representing the organizational system by a family of models. They must represent certain levels of the organization that simultaneously possess the specified property. As an instrument for ensuring adaptability, appropriate management is considered. Uncertainty is one of the key features of adaptive management of the organization.

articleTitle: Information support in agri-insurance
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the use of available information on crop yields in crop insurance programs. The information problems arising at the insurance of the income from the produced crop production are discussed.

articleTitle: Machine learning. A method of approximation of discriminant functions and two methods of estimation of a posterior probabilities of classes in the problem of classification
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The method of approximating a discriminant functions of the training set is proposed. The sign of the discriminant functions allows us to classify the point in one or another class. The approximation is constructed with greater precision in the neighborhood of zero values of the discriminant function. To estimate a posterior probability of a class of a point two methods are proposed: based on a series of discriminant functions constructed from the training set and a method in which for each point a personal approximation of the discriminant function is constructed that takes a zero value at a given point. At points where the discriminant function is zero a posterior probability of the class are the same and depend only on the ratio of the values of classification errors.

Author Keywords: estimate of a posterior probability of the class

articleTitle: Mathematical models for enterprise resource scheduling: Complexity of key approaches to problem formulation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper gives overview of two modern approaches to enterprise resources scheduling problem: continuous time problem setting that leads to a combinatorial set of classical linear programming models and discrete time approach that gives an integer programming model. We follow the main steps of problem formulating and find decision points where the researcher chooses which model and computational method to apply. The main objective of this research is to compare both approaches from the computational complexity point of view. We consider several special cases of mass and individual manufacturing and define which approach is more applicable for each of them. In practice this advice can be used in particular cases to reduce hardware requirements to the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and in certain cases can help improve its performance avoiding implementing big data techniques.

articleTitle: Advance payments and recalculation of the amounts of financing
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of using advance payments when applying the principle of equal profitability is considered to determine the amount of funding for performance of work by implementing agents that are monopolists. Formation of conditions that exclude the interest of agents in overstating the cost estimates for the performance of work.

articleTitle: On victorious renaissance of large-scale market mythology in Russia in the period of transformation reforms
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Socio-economic characteristics of the systems crisis which was brought about to Russia during the reforms period and was caused by implementing “shock therapy” are examined. Its main negative and positive consequences for the country are noted and the most important reasons for it are systematized. They include both conducting reforms on the basis of “Washington Consensus” provisions and ignoring economic peculiarities of the Russian state and society. Formulations and content of the main myths of implementing reforms are given, as well as their possible consequences.

articleTitle: Models of company's capital structure: Classification and analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: There are proposed company's capital structure models that can be used in an automated monitoring system and preliminary analysis of the risks of the company's assets financing. It is developed classification of the main structures of assets financing.

articleTitle: Integrated systems of regional programming
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses features of integrated systems of regional programming and their formation from separate systems of regional planning and design using an automatic synthesis of interface programs. Each integrated system exists as a single unit only in the form of a computer model and is built for specific tasks.

articleTitle: Minimum yield principle under incomplete prediction of financial markets
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The work investigates the properties of the solutions derived from the minimum yield principle in problems of constructing optimal in continuous VaR-criterion (CC-VaR) portfolio for an investor with own partial market forecast and own risk preferences function. Fundamental theoretical results are adduced and illustrated by examples of two-sided exponential, equiprobability, and beta distributions both for more underly's price and market forecast.

articleTitle: Think tanks as an intellectual basis to make effective decisions
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Modernization of Russia determine the need for full integration of domestic economic and political systems into global processes. In this regard, the study of the problem of Think Tanks is particularly relevant. The use of comprehensive experience of Think Tanks is possible in the development of management strategies, the development of concepts and programs, socio-economic policy, the organization of political and economic consulting in our country.

articleTitle: Algorithmization of schemes of the Monte Carlo methods in tasks of control problems on the ranks of historical data
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This work contains the explanation of theoretical plans concerning the use various heuristic schemes of the solution of tasks of management in practical projects. In this case the uncertain factors are presented only by a finite set of historical data.

articleTitle: A modeling and choice of strategic investment decisions in oligopoly markets
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper examines the problem of choice investment strategies of firms in an oligopoly markets. We study the impact of investment strategies of companies on its financial performance and the efficiency of investment under demand uncertainty and competition in the market. A mathematical model describing the investment behavior of firms in an oligopoly markets presented. A solution of the problem reduced to the analysis of the bi-matrix game, wherein the matrix of wins formed by numerical simulation. We presented and analyzed the results of calculations of the proposed approach for example the problem of investment strategies choice of oil companies with conventional and unconventional oil production.

articleTitle: Scenario planning of activities of the group of aeronautical robotic engineering complexes in cooperative environments
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of a component of stability of a communication network - survivability which is understood as maintenance of demanded level of an information exchange in grouping of the robots forming an aeromobile communication network, in the conditions of destroying influences is designated. In this case probably full collapse of a network, not only because of the conflict, but also as a result of increasing loadings on separate hub sites which will be incapable to pass the increased information highways. For increase disaster tolerance in operation driving of inside territorially distributed grouping of robots along a circuit of the maximum flow of a network of an information exchange is offered. For determination of the maximum flow the discrete estimation with usage of Pi-cycles is offered.

articleTitle: On equivalence of linear problems of efficiency and risk control under uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Linear two-criteria problems of efficiency and risk control are considered. The minimax risk function and the risk function in the polyhedral 1-metric as risk assessment are used. Two-criteria problems are formalized in the form of the sum type convolution of the efficiency and risk criteria and of the ratio type convolution. It is shown that the solutions of the corresponding linear decision-making problems coincide. The relations are found in the explicit form between the parameters of all problems for which they are equivalent.

articleTitle: Analysis methods of financial time series based on the use of the hurst exponent
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The report considers the modified Peters algorithm to calculate the Hurst exponent (HE), the essential properties of HE are proved, an example, analysis of a random time series is given.

articleTitle: The nature of National Classification systems. Problems and solutions
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents core information about National Classification of Economic Activities, National Classification of Product by Economic Activities, National classification of fixed assets. The description of problems and their solutions is presented.

articleTitle: Public-private partnerships in large-scale infrastructure in Russia: Opportunities and challenges
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Modernization of large-scale infrastructure is one of the main economic problems in Russia. The subject of analysis is Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) in Russian infrastructure in the framework of the federal laws on concessions and PPPs entered into legal force in 2005 and 2015 respectively. Particular attention is also paid to the administrative scheme of selection of investment projects to provide state support. The author's general conclusion is that despite the existing problems in Russia and around the world PPPs remains one of the most important instruments for financing development large-scale infrastructure.

articleTitle: About the possibilities of classic and operational gaming modeling in support of decision-making on the management of enterprises and corporations
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The possibilities of gaming simulation to support the adoption of a broad range of planned and operational decisions in the management of enterprises and corporations are considered. The capabilities developed to date tools game modeling and original approach based on a synthesis of basic concepts of game theory and operations research with the ideas analytical accounting, the strict definition of economic facts in the form of static games (pending dynamic ensembles of static games) are compared. The possibilities of simulation of real decision-making procedures and information flow in high-tech companies and corporations are analyzed.

articleTitle: Efficient mechanisms to reduce dimensions of the problem of seeking the critical power plant nodes
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Consideration was given to efficient mechanisms to reduce dimensions of the problem of seeking the critical power plant nodes built in the classical algorithms for seeking on graph a network endangered by negative actions.

articleTitle: Using regular binary sequences for active identification of systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The identification methods of the objects are reviewed (active and passive). The method of active identification for closed-loop control system is proposed. The efficiency of using of the regular binary sequence for determining the temporal characteristics of objects is shown. The analysis is made for different constraints: on the output deviation range and on the variance of the output's useful component. The article discusses the use of a priori information about the signal. The estimates of mathematical expectation and variance of process are obtained by changing steam temperature in the upper radiation part of boiler on Ladyzhynskaya State District Power Station (SDPS).

articleTitle: An investigation of the information base actualization time when using automated and automatic tools
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Using automatic instead of automated tools is assumed to significantly reduce timing budgets needed for the actualization. However, it seems to be not always the case, especially if we consider the complete actualization cycle. The article presents an investigation of the time needed for the information base actualization when using separate automated or automatic tools, as well as the time needed for the complete actualization cycle. A brief review of the Upper Level Control System information base, whose timing budgets were investigated, is also presented.

articleTitle: About some issues of development of control systems for the large-scale objects state
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The questions connected with the use of the modern element base in the development of some types of monitoring and monitoring systems for large-scale objects are considered.

articleTitle: Situational control algorithm for ensuring parameter stability in unique software and hardware
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In order to ensure the stability of unique software and hardware parameters in a spacecraft's onboard system, a situational control algorithm is being offered. The proposed approach allows to minimize errors when processing external influence test results. A mechanism of minimization of ground test numbers for a single copy device is formed.

articleTitle: On stability margins assessment for electrical power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of the distributed generation integration into the main network related to the dynamic interaction of the main network generators with large inertia with distributed generation which have a small inertia, are considered. As a result of this interaction, there are dangerous weakly stable oscillations, which can lead to the breakdown of consumers technological equipment, or electrical equipment in the main network. Modal analysis is the main method of the dangerous oscillations monitoring in the world. The method involves calculating the eigenvalues (modes) of the system's dynamics matrix and determining the eigenvalue with the maximum real part. The subgramians method allows to calculate the current energy value of the weakly stable modes accumulated in their group, which is the basis of a new technology for the stability margins estimating based on energy criteria. The main attention is paid to modal analysis and the method of gramians, their comparison and description of the hybrid method of small signal stability analysis are given.

articleTitle: Application of synergetic and fractal methods in the implementation of the environmental audit system
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The decline of the environmental situation in the world generates a need for regular drinking water quality monitoring as well as for the efficient nature management system development. An introduction to the concept of a fractal-synergetic approach to the procedure for conducting the environmental audit to support decision-making in the environmental management based on the virtual reality technology is given in this article. The necessity for application of Synergetics and fractal modeling in the implementation of the expert-analytical system of the environmental audit is substantiated.

articleTitle: Selection of gas flow distribution in the gas gathering network
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the technique of calculation of steady state pressure and flow distribution of raw gas in gas gathering networks of gas fields, providing a given level of total production from wells and satisfying technological limitations in the form of boundary conditions. Since the group gathering schemes using the internal energy of the gas at the well head are treelike configurations of gas pipelines, the solution of the general problem of choosing a stationary mode is reduced to solving a sequence of one-dimensional nonlinear equations with a monotonic function of an unknown argument by recognized highly efficient methods.

articleTitle: The evolution of space-rocket technology for improving the energy capabilities and launch safety of liquid-propellant rockets
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The means for enhancing the efficiency of rocket propulsion of spacecraft considered in terms of the control of propellant consumption. The second problem lies in maximizing the safety criterion by controlling the shutdown instant of the lower-stage engine by information about the booster phantom velocity and measurements of the propellant component reserves.

articleTitle: Financial modeling of higher educational institution using quality management approaches
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A possibility of applying modern quality management methods to improve the efficiency of financial activities of higher education institutions is considered in this paper. Quality management can be applied not only to the production of goods or services, but also to improve the quality of any process. Accordingly some aspects of quality management can be applied to the financial processes of the university. In particular, Ishikawa diagram and House of Quality can be used to create a financial model of the university, which can help to improve the decisions making process. The goals and objectives that should be solved to create the model and a way of its application are set in this paper.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the variability of the pulse signal parameters of the radial artery in the problems of differential medical diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The variability of the parameters of the signal of the pulse the radial artery in a number of diseases assessed, in particular, the early stage of arterial hypertension in childhood and adolescence, mitral valve prolapse, lung cancer. The ratios of the vibrational components of vegetative regulation for various types of diseases revealed. It is shown that the degree of variability depends, in part, on the parameter of the pulse signal studied. In particular, in the detection of arterial hypertension, the greatest variability and diagnostic significance occur in the study of the dicrotic wave of the pulse signal. In this case, the same indicators significantly exceeded when examining the duration of the pulse signal - an analogue of the heart rhythm. The received estimations of variation of parameters of a pulse signal allow form purposefully informative signs at carrying out of differential diagnostics of diseases.

Author Keywords: Pulse signal of the radial artery

articleTitle: Long-term control of regional development: Population density and human potential
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The modified (due to ergodic hypothesis using) Poincaré transversal cutting surface method is proposed for studying control effectiveness from data of a “passive” experiment. The obtained quasi-recurrence-plots map makes it possible to identify lagging and successfully developing regions according to achieved level of the density of the population and level of human development.

articleTitle: The use of principal component analysis in creating an composite indicators of change in the quality of system
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In the article is given the method of constructing the integral characteristics of changes quality a system based on the recorded measurements. Constructing of latent composite indicators of changes of the quality system on the basis of statistical indicators for a number of consecutive observations is based on the principal component method, taking into account the presence of noise in the measured data (SNR-based algorithm). The algorithm provides signal isolation in a multidimensional data array with noise under conditions of a priory uncertainty about the properties of the signal based on a given signal-to-noise ratio. In classical PCA informativeness of composite indicators is given a prior and is provided by selecting the number of principal components. In the proposed algorithm the information content of the solution is evaluated a posteriori on the basis of variance criterion and the selected parameter signal-to-noise ratio. With the proposed algorithm is construction integral indicators of the quality of life of regions of the Russian Federation for the years 2007-2014.

Author Keywords: informativity of the Principal Components Analysis

articleTitle: Generating scalable optimization and multi-agent research models from high-level analytical descriptions: Long-term and medium-term forecasts for the economic and energy sector development
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Economic forecasts for decision-making and research purposes are usually based on fairly complex models. Once created, models often require updates to meet new requirements and/or implement new methodology. This paper considers modelling tools, which allow non-programming specialists to build efficient executable models from analytical description written in high-level domain-specific language and provide extensibility when new modelling methodology needs to be added. Current implementation allows users to create linear and multi-linear optimization models (to find and analyze the best possible scenarios of economic development), and multi-agent models (to use behavioral rules for more precise economic analysis, especially for the crisis periods).

articleTitle: Determination method and optimization in the interval uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Existing approaches to system optimization (optimal design) under uncertainty are considered. The exact formulation of constrained optimization problem with interval uncertainty of goal function and constraints parameters is given. Mathematical theory of intervals comparison including the precise definition of minimum and maximum ranges is stated. On the basis of this theory the determination method is formulated and justified which allows solving problems by reducing to a two fully certain constrained optimization problems of the same type.

articleTitle: The combinatorial modelling of energy development options
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes the combinatorial modeling approach to the research of energy sector development. The idea of the approach is to model a system development in the form of a directed graph which nodes correspond to the possible states of a system at certain moments of time and arcs characterize the possibility of transitions from one state to another.

articleTitle: A model for assessment the effectiveness of company management for decision-making by investors
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed model is intended to assessment of company's operation effectiveness, which is an important factor at investment decisions making. There are compared indicators of the growth rate, profitability and risk for shares placed on various stock exchanges with an assessment of the intrinsic value and management efficiency of company. The information received is useful for investors and company managers for operating on stock markets.

Author Keywords: model for assessment of the company's management efficiency

articleTitle: Macroeconomic model of the scientific-technological progress
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors give a brief review of the existing approaches to modeling scientific-technological progress (STP) on the macro-level. The author's model of STP is offered which in a certain sense is developing these known approaches. In this model, along with using the categories of the economic (fixed) capital and human capital, the factors of the scientific-technological capital are operationalized, which has two levels. The first level refers to the fundamental capital responsible for the transition to the new technological mode and the second one refers to the applied capital determining the growth of the factor productivity within one technological mode.

articleTitle: Promoting the coincidence of different partitioning types at large-scale network
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Conditions and optimum incentive function determined for coincidence of various types partitioning to polygons at large-scale network. The presented results may be useful for the development of organizational structures and management mechanisms at large-scale network systems such as rail and road transport, electric power networks, pipeline systems, information networks, etc.

articleTitle: Simulation modeling training on the example of building of the information and control system model
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes issues related to training in simulation model building in the aerospace sector. The simulation model of the information and control system capable to solve problems of system structure analysis and optimization is described. A number of software packages are reviewed.

articleTitle: On visual analytics methods at modelling of ill-structured situations and large-scale systems based on cognitive maps
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The use of cognitive maps in support of solving practical problems of analysis of ill-structured situations and large-scale systems in economics, medicine, ecology, education and military-political sphere is growing. The problem of visual perception and understanding of cognitive maps is proven to be extremely urgent and practically important. The set of visualization methods that provide better perception and understanding is proposed. The methods are based on the one hand on cognitive models of “the perceiving person” and on the other, on mathematical features of cognitive maps.

articleTitle: Information security subsystems standardization issues in designing large scale Information systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The methodological aspects of building standardized profiles describing the development of a security system that is an integral part of a distributed information system are considered. Functional standardization instruments and the theory of open systems are used.

articleTitle: Modeling of unified information internet space of the country
