publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the economic and mathematical model of forming unified information Internet space for scientific and educational resources by integration of scientific and educational resources in certain “cloud”, based on the needs of consumers, the possibility of required generation in information sources and the availability of nodes (providers) in the network to organize the process of receiving, transmitting and storing information flows.

articleTitle: Buckley-Leverett's filtration model and time-optimal oil fields development
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Time-optimal management of the development of oil fields discussed. We use one-dimensional Buckley-Leverett filtering model.

articleTitle: Identification and dating of “bubbles” on financial markets: Comparison of posterior algorithms and monitoring algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The report is devoted to comparison of existing methods of detecting changes (structural breaks) in random processes designed to detect the appearance of bubbles in financial markets. The report considers and compares the estimates obtained by monitoring algorithms and posterior algorithms for the purpose of determining the existence and date of the “bubble”.

articleTitle: Yearly frequent cases of acute respiratory viral infection among chemical industry employees: Risk assessment and individual morbidity
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A method for increased risk assessment of annual cases of acute respiratory viral infection using single-time immuno-epidemiological study data is proposed. Mechanisms of impact of immunity indicators, health status, and factors of environmental pollution on individual morbidity of a chemical industry employee are studied and predicted in affiliation with the risk group. The method can be recommended for a supplementary analysis of screening data of industry employees.

articleTitle: Issues of management of the support sports training system on the regional level and ways of their solving: On the example of Moscow city
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A support system sports training is considered as a socio-economic system, describes its main components, functions, and approaches to create. Described the international experience of creation and functioning of organisation of a system of support athletic training, based on different principles. Characterized the state of the sport industries and the characteristics the system of support athletic training in Moscow. Lists issues of management and development of the system of support athletic training and the reasons generating them. Designed ways to further improve the management of the support sports training system. Gives examples of successful projects in the sports sector in Moscow.

articleTitle: The singular mechanisms to synthesis and functioning of promising computational structures of aerospace complexes
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The fundamental principle of the evolution of all material and element base of neural computing, in particular, is the preservation of the singularity of the mechanisms of its synthesis and functioning shown. The development of control algorithms and self-organization lies in the field of compatibility to singular processes and structures, where the neural associative computing has apparent advantages over the traditional.

articleTitle: Inventory control policies for random lead times
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Updates to classical two-level inventory control policies are discussed for inventory control systems (ICS) with random lead times. The conventional zero time ICS-model problem is stated. The solution lies in the two criteria generalization of the conventional inventory control problem. Formulas are derived for calculating corrections to the classical inventory control problem variables. Simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Repeated game with the undergoing changes set of choices of the second player
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Some optimum regime of the information receipt is found in the non - antagonistic repeated game of two players. The set of choices of the second player is changed in time according to one of some variants. The variants of change are known till the beginning of the game. There is a finite number of variants. The income during the game information permits to ascertain the true variant.

Author Keywords: optimum regime of the information receipt

articleTitle: The centralisation and decentralisation in the control
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Simplest models are examined to estimate the expediency procedures of the centralization or decentralization at the control of the complex systems.

Author Keywords: information theory of the hierarchical systems

articleTitle: Indirect estimations of current quality indicators of the process unit material flows and their correlation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper reviews alternative indirect estimates of current quality indicators of processing unit material flows within time intervals between their direct evaluating with a discrete laboratory analysis.

Author Keywords: alternative indirect estimates of quality indicators
statistical methods for indirect estimation of material flows quality

articleTitle: Analysis of open dynamical systems' models with the help of stochastic differential equations (based on the example of macroeconomic growth models)
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article gives consideration to the problem of the open dynamic systems' modeling. We propose its solution with the help of stochastic systems of differential equations. We provide the methodology of modeling and analyze the certain example.

articleTitle: Simulation of inventory control process for supply chain with several suppliers
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A multi-step discrete-time inventory control problem that occurs in the supply chain with several alternative suppliers is described in this paper. Algorithms for constructing optimal strategies for inventory control and suppliers selection are proposed. Simulation results are provided.

articleTitle: The main functionality of smart training system for experts in analytical centers
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Training and retraining of experts oriented to the work in the Analytical Centers requires the use of modern training technologies. It is promising to create and integrate into the Analytical Center structure an Intelligent Training System that provides dynamic experts training in a mixed (offline / online) information space, taking into account their motivation, level of education, information and communication skills and professional interests.

articleTitle: Efficiency of West European countries' mortgage housing loan markets. Econometric approach
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Estimates were obtained for the optimal possible sizes and the efficiencies of the organization of the West European countries' mortgage housing loan markets given the real, actual values of macroeconomic indicators of the countries. Two the most and two the least efficient markets were compared by several characteristics of their organization. The main research tool was the econometric method of the stochastic frontier production function.

articleTitle: The problems of modeling and experience of the numerical research of the mortgage coalitions
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Processes of dynamic formation of the coalitions in tasks of mortgage lending are considered, an influence of uncertain factors on functioning and efficiency of the organization of the coalition of borrowers is investigated, the corresponding mathematical models are written out, results of computing experiments are given.

articleTitle: Development of information exchange of software and hardware tools of system of test of difficult scientific-technical objects
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The issues of software and hardware development are considered of data logging into systems of testing complex objects. The describes the architecture of a system for testing complex scientific-technical objects. In the list of original elements of the concept of building highly reliable, fast-reconfigurable interactive test monitoring and control systems: - using of original technology of representation dynamic parameters of the current process of test management for the process to simplify the process of making reasonable and effective operational decisions; - using of classification analysis algorithms (for determining the periodicity in the study of the rhythmic structure of complex signals) that increase the informative of the parametric estimates obtained; - using of hierarchically detailed 3-D representations to the operator of the state of the control system and the object under test; - using of methods and algorithms for preemptive criterial adaptation for guaranteed preservation of controllability conditions and prevention of abnormal conditions; - using of the method of modeling the process of targeted selection and making decisions on the evaluation of test results, based on a structurally linked set of requirements for the characteristics of the evaluated objects. In the work, some aspects of the development of the interconnection of software and hardware for providing data logging during testing of complex objects, including for diagnosing and forecasting work processes with the purpose of preventing the development of emergency situations, are sketched out.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of inflationary process in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes the main indicators of inflation and determining its macroeconomic indicators, which can be the basis for monitoring economic and financial policy of Russia. The basis of the work is regional and General analysis of the indicators characterizing monetary and price processes.

Author Keywords: macroeconomic indicators monetary and price processes

articleTitle: The role of consulting companies in encouragement of foreign direct investment
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors of the article analyze the current situation in Russia in the area of foreign direct investment encouragement and capabilities of private consulting firms to facilitate encouragement of FDI, acting as an intermediary between investors and companies that require project financing.

articleTitle: Obtaining of discontinuous solutions from multivalued solutions of nonlinear differential equations in the problem of multiphase filtration of hydrocarbons
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of obtaining single-valued solutions from multi-valued solutions of nonlinear differential equations. The discussion is focused on multi-valued solutions with complex geometric shapes. The paper discusses theoretical issues and some aspects of creating a numerical solution.

articleTitle: Towards the search system of attractors in three-dimensional phase space
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss our experiences in developing a software system for investigating third-order dynamics of the Rapoport-Leas equation as attractors for the solutions of this equation. The primary goal of developing the system in general terms is to visual study the model of one-dimensional displacement of immiscible fluids with allowance for capillary forces using the methods of the geometric theory of differential equations. If necessary, the system can be used to study other evolutionary partial differential equations by the same methods.

articleTitle: Forecast of functional state of object under conditions of behavior uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The relevance of the task of developing methods for forecasting the condition of the tracking object is shown, since the results of its solution affect the quality of its functioning as a whole. A method for forecasting the functional state of an escort object in conditions of behavioral uncertainty is presented, based on a gradient descent in the space of functional states.

articleTitle: Critical facilities of Russian gas transport network: The ways of their determining and minimizing the consequences of the emergencies
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents approaches to the formation of the list of critical facilities in the Russian gas transmission network from the standpoint of energy security and ways to reduce the negative consequences for emergencies in them. Using the example of separate gas transportation network facilities, it is shown: what negative consequences, expressed in relative volumes of shortage of natural gas, can occur as a result of disruption of the operation of these facilities until their complete shutdown and what invariant steps can be taken to minimize such negative consequences.

articleTitle: Problems of effective using of storage and protection systems of slightly documents in the microelectronic industry
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Due to the growth of the number and volume of accumulated documents, there arises the problem of storing documents, as well as their safe use and transmission by means of internal LANs of enterprises and the Internet. Existing ways to reduce the size of documents do not provide the necessary efficiency of document storage. Using the lexicological synthesis can significantly reduce the size of documents, as well as to increase their security.

articleTitle: The mechanism of the casual choice in the investors coalition
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of decision-making by the coalition of borrowers are considered. The main participants of housing crediting are borrowers and creditors. To find a compromise between contract savings, mortgage lending, state support the mathematical model for financial processes is used. The optimizing task for calculation of mortgage contracts parameters in the case of using the casual mechanism to the choice participant who is the recipient of the credit is formulated.

articleTitle: Methodological approach for harmonization of the investment and pricing policy options in the electric power industry
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents the methodological approach to the substantiation of the pricing policy parameters required for the stable development of the power industry in the long run. For this purpose, a multi-level system of financial models is developed and used to forecast the changes in the financial health of the whole electric power industry, its main technological sectors and separate generating and grid companies under given investment plans, regulatory policy scenarios and types of the electricity market structure. The rational hierarchy of modeling tasks is specified in the article, according to different levels of the investment planning (from industry to project level). The proposed integrated approach to the substantiation of the pricing decisions in the areas of competitive market or tariff regulation ensures the assessment of their consequences (“direct” problem) as well as the estimation of target price levels of electricity and heat generation or grid services based on the revenue requirement calculations (“reverse” problem). Being developed for the electric power industry, this integrated approach can be applied for the most of energy industries and markets.

articleTitle: The strategy of green university: Russian experience of implementation
publicationTitle: 2017 Tenth International Conference Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Education plays an important role in sustainable development. So universities need to abandon the role of passive transfer of sustainable development knowledge and take an active role in planning of social, environmental and economic development of their countries and Russia is no exception. This paper analyzes the practices of green strategy of Russian universities. Chronology of events and decisions determining the principles of sustainable development strategies for universities was studied. This paper investigates the practice of implementing the key functions in the sustainable development strategy of Russian universities. It deals with benefits and barriers in implementation of green university's strategy based on data collected from survey of various website of educational institutions (universities) and overall discussion and analysis. The analysis has shown that Russian universities use only a few suitable green approaches and they are not integrated into the holistic strategy. But the trends of the environment and rapid growth of interest at Russian universities in sustainable development strategy make it possible to conclude that the situation will be better soon.
